about.title: 📢 SITCON 2026
about.venue: @ Academia Sinica Humanities and Social Sciences Building
about.aboutDesc1: Students’ Information Technology Conference (SITCON) was initiated in 2012, organized by students for students, dedicated to information education and open source spirit.
about.aboutDesc2: We hope to inspire more students to enter the world of information, gather at the conference, exchange ideas, and practice the concept of 'learning by doing, teaching and learning together'.
about.cocDesc1: SITCON welcomes participants from all backgrounds and identities, and encourages diversity. To ensure everyone enjoys the event, all participants are required to read the conference
about.cocDesc2: , and help create a friendly environment together.
about.joinDesc1: SITCON is an open community. Many preparation matters are discussed publicly on the
about.joinDesc2: . If you are interested, feel free to subscribe and contribute your ideas. If you want to join next year's team, check out the recruitment page!
about.joinDesc3: If you want to learn more about SITCON's preparation and discussions, visit
about.joinDesc4: to see the progress of SITCON 2026.
